text.body:
{śrīgovindakaulaviracitā śrīgurustutiratnāvalī}
śrīdevyai namaḥ ||
oṃ śrīgurave śivāyo namaḥ ||
śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ ||
śrīrastu ||
sākṣāt kṛtya nijaṃ svarū(?)pamamalaṃ yadhānavipruṇmayaṃ | hitvā bhrāntimatiṃ maheśa iti yo devarṣimattyaiḥ stutaḥ ||
baddhān bhaktajanān vimocayati satkāruṇyadṛṣṭyā kṣaṇāt | kauleśaṃ kula (*?) guruvaraṃ vāgme(?) prabhuṃ sāhibam || 1 ||
yasyaikasya vibhorvibhāvika sarāt prodetv)(?9 viśvaṃ sthitiṃ | vyāpnotyaṃ śunimeṣaṇāt kṣaṇamapi pratyastamāyātya ho ||
svacchandaṃ satatoditaṃ sakalagaṃ pūrṇaṃ viśuddhaṃ sadā nāsyā nandanidhiṃ cidasvaramaṇiṃ śrīsāhibaṃ taṃ śivam || 2 ||
ādāvādhārapadmāt pratibhuvanamalaṃ bhāsayandva prabhābhiśśritvā'mandāravindākaramamṛta vapuḥ pādakañja srutairyaḥ ||
siñcan pīyūṣavarṣaiḥ suramunipitṛkān kārmikāṃ stīthya saṅghān brahmāṇḍāgāra śambhuḥ sphurati paramahastad bhaje sāhibākhyam || 3 ||
dhātā yasya padābjavandana rasātsargaṃ tarotīśate ||
viṣṇurjiṣṇusakhā ca rakṣati padāmbhojārcanāt saṃhṛtim | rudraśceśa sadāśivau trijagato bhrūbhaṅgi śiṣṭyāpidhāṃ (* * * *?) yaśavi (* *) (*?) paraśivaṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ tvārcaye || 4 ||
tvaṃ svātantryaruciśca bhaktajanatādhīnātmakastraṃ prabho || tvaṃ viśvāśraya tattva bhūtijanitā tvaṃ tatvato'nāśritaḥ ||
tvaṃ kṛtsnajña vidhātṛtādyavayavī tvaṃ kañcukāntarhita || stvaṃ kāruṇyanidhistva pāramahimā śrīsāhibaṃ tvāṃ stuve || 5 ||
kāyankāyati kalpitaḥ kilaśilākalpā hṛṣīṃka vrajā || hṛṣyanti prabhavo (*?) pi sambhavalayobhāveṣu kartuṃ sphuṭam ||
prāṇaḥ prāṇati yanmarīcikalayā taṃ jīvajīvaṃ śivaṃ || cinnāthaṃ sahajaṃ nijaṃ gurutamaṃ dhāmāśraye sāhibam || 6 ||
māyāsupta samastajantu tati ṣūjjāgatyi(?)jasraṃ ca yaḥ || ṣaḍbhāvāṃ vikṛtiṃ vivartayati yosau nirvikāraḥ svayam ||
e(?)koneka tayā svaśakti laharī vṛndairnijaṃ khelaya || nnaikākāra ivāvugra vainumitastaṃbhāvaye sāhibam || 7 ||
kartā tarkanaye vimukta puruṣaḥ sāṅkhye jinassaugate || śabdātmā dhvaniśāsane vidhiyutaṃ karmāyane gai(?)mineḥ ||
brahmaikaṃ śrutimastake harirayaṃ yo gīyate vaiṣṇave || śaive śambhuraśeṣa tūpamamalaṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ saṃśraye || 8 ||
nityā hlādamayaṃ nirāmayamamuṃ nivūta tīthyāṃ hasaṃ || nirdvandvā kalanaṃ nirādinidhanaṃ nirdvaita bodhātmakam nisspandasphuritaṃ niruttarakalā śliṣṭaṃ guruṃ nirmalaṃ niśśeṣāśrayamīśvaraṃ nirupamaṃ nityaṃ smare sāhibam || 9 || sa |
vasmyota vimarśaharṣavapuṣānāke prakāśyābhito || yena prāgdivi satyabodhabharitaṃ tejassamullāsitam ||
svaṃ svacchaṃ pratibhāsvabhāvasubhagaṃ corvyāṃ prasarttuṃ priyāñśiṣyān kāruṇikaṃ śivaṃ navatanuṃ preḍe guruṃ sāhibam || 10 ||
yanmūrtinbhavane mahātmabhairalaṃ dhyeyā sahasracchade || padme mūrdhni sitāsvarā trinayanā somāsanāsomabhāḥ || cindudrāvara pustakātayakarā vāmā va devyaṅktā || bhaktānugrahatatparā paraśivaṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ bhāvaye || 11 ||
antavāya bhujokalā ca śaśinobhālekṣaṇaṃ bhūtale || soyaṃ śaṅkaranātha eva viharannācāryagātra sthitaḥ || sākṣānnrūndayate parādvaya dṛśā sammuktamuttyāgirā || saścitsātaghanaṃ tu sāhibamimaṃ taṃ tvāṃ namasye śivam || 12 ||
ya podadvaya nirgalat parasudhā dhārābhirā rādhakān || santarpyā'virataṃ padābja śaraṇāndāsāndvametyāḥ svabhaḥ || svāmīsvarviṣayāti śāyimuditaṃ datte prabhutvamahajja | vandu | kta | va bhūṣitaṃ paraśivaṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ saṃsmare || 13 ||
tārātmā bha(?)vatārako'mara yutairlokeśa keśeśvarai || rekoyokhila vāṅmayāmṛta nidhiściddharṣa pūrṇo dhruvaḥ || brahmāṇḍādvipulopyaṇoraṇutamo jyotistamo jyotiṣāṃ || svātmaithyāt parimṛśyate paraśivaṃ taṃ sambhaje sāhibam || 14 ||
vāgyasmāt praṇatārtināśana paṭunmandākinī veśvarād || dhṛtkāluṣyamṛjākṣamā munimatā pūtā prasādāspadā || srotovistṛti bhāgavātara dahe tīthāthi sāthārcitā || viśveśaṃ gurusattamaṃ śivakaraṃ vande vibhuṃ sāhibam || 15 ||
māyeyaṃ mahitā pradhānamahilā svātantrya līlotsavā || svāsvābhāvika bhāvabhāva paṭalīdvaita prathādāyinī || yasye śasya ca kāstibhāva viyutāḥ ke mohitānoyayā || dutbodhātmikayā triviṣṭapa guruṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ saṃśraye || 16 ||
lakṣmīryasya jagatprabhoravirataṃ pādābja saktāśayai || styaktā kṛttrimatvapatopyakṛtakā nandādṛḍhaṃ śaśritā || sphūrjadbhuktya vibhakta mukti virbhavātaṃ pūrṇaśaktiṃ vibhuṃ || śrīnāthaṃ gurucakravattinamahaṃ naumīśvaraṃ sāhibam || 17 ||
ākāśo'stu vi(?)kāśate sitakaraḥ snigdho yathā sevyate || sarvaddhiśca janāndanaḥ suragaṇaiścaṇḍānalaujāsthā || trailokye'pi kalāḍhya candra rucirovandyoya īśodvayo || māheśai bhajatāṃ śaraṇyamaniśaṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ tvāṃ stuve śambhustvaṃ paraśaktimāṃstu sakala kleśaika vaiśvā naraḥ ||
saṃvartastvamanāśyadainya gahane tvaṃ kālakālo mahān || indrastvaṃ varuṇānilau madhuripussābjopya khaṇḍātmakastvāṃ śrīsāhibamarcayāmi sakalottīrṇaṃ maheśaṃ gurum || 19 ||
candrārke kṣaṇamaṣṭa śaktigiriśaṃdyomastakaṃ nābhikhaṃ || kukṣisthāmvunidhiṃ hutāśavadanaṃ sūkṣmāmṛtābhāsitam || dikkarṇaṃ caraṇakṣitiṃ khalujagatprāṇaṃtva krūrātmakaṃ || śrīnāthaṃ suvirājamadbhutatanuṃ tvāṃ sāhibaṃ bhāvaye || 20 ||
śaṅkarāśya śaniṃ nabhoti pṛthulaṃ nityaṃ nutaṃ nirjaraiḥ || śrī vai kuṇṭhapinākināyakassarvaiḥ pīyūṣaharṣātmakam || yaugāntāgni nibhaṃ jagadguru garīyāṃ saṃhṛdisthaṃ śivaṃ || śāntyā krāntamanuttaraṃ dhruvamajaṃ vande vibhuṃ sāhibam || 21 ||
śrīviśveśvara bhairavoti karuṇo harṣeśvarī saṃyutaḥ || sāmnāyā gama sampradāyasumaṇīṃścopādi dikṣaśśritān || avyakto'pi kṛpāvatāramamalaṃvyānāñja bodhodadhiṃ || yaṃ kauleśapatiṃ viśālayaśasaṃjīyādasau sāhibaḥ || 22 ||
yaśśūnyā kṛti pūrṇaśakti khacitaḥ śūnyālayassansudhā nandāḍhyo bhuvanaṃ pipatti sakalaṃ yonirguṇo niṣkalaḥ || dvaitādvaita kalāśrayopi munibhiryogīśvarairgīyate || cidrūpaṃ gurupuṣkalaṃ paraśivaṃ taṃ sāhibaṃ saṃśraye || 23 ||
brahmāmnāya sarasvatī śritamukho'haṃ sasthitaḥ prītimān || drāksaṅkarṣaṇa caivatāgrima mahāsenādi yuktassvayam || śrīnāthaṃ satataṃ gṛṇāti jagatī jaittraṃ yamīttyaṃ guro || rmūrtisthaṃ praṇatosmitaṃ paraśivaṃ śrīsāhibaṃ sarvayaḥ || 24 ||
mantrāmāntrikamantryarūpa bhagavandevādhi deva prabho || śrīśrīkaula kuleśa deśika parānandādināthā bhayam || śaktyāśliṣṭa vapuḥ prasannavadanodatsaveraṃ cepsitaṃ || nityaṃ śrīparapādukāṃ ca śivayorvāṃ prajayāsyānataḥ || 25 ||
pāśaidhodahanaṃ hṛdutpala sudhārasmiṃstuve tvāṃ mṛḍaṃ dvaita dhvāntaraviṃ tridhāmadharaṇiṃ śrīsāhibaṃ sadgurum || pūjyāṅghre śivapālanāt sudurita dhvaṃsāśca kāsyārpaṇāt smattṛṇāṃ triṇuṇādhipā vijayate śrīpādukāte śubhā || 26 ||
yo devatraya valvya vīryavibhavopya vendulekhojjvalaḥ || saṃcetyaugha nirodhināda gaganāntastho mahāvyāpakaḥ || cittattva spṛgamogha śaktiruditoyaśconmanācetanas || tatvajñaiḥ praṇutositaṃ paraśivaṃ tvaṃ sāhibaṃ sambhaje || 27 ||
kālākāradigādya kṛttavapuṣo dhyānaṃ nu kiṃ te vibho || tvaṃ viṣvakjagaditārtha janakopyarcā vidhiste katham || ādikṣānta suvarṇabhāsvaratanoḥ kāte stutiḥ sāhibaṃ || satyaṃ śāntamanuttamaṃ guruvaraṃ taṃ tvāṃ prapadye prabhum || 28 ||
snātvādau pariśuddha bindusarasaściścandra sāndrāmṛtaiḥ || prokṣyādhāradharāṃ svabhāva kusumaisturyā jā(?) vīdyotitaiḥ || kṛtvā nandamurdhaugha pūrṇahṛdayānarghārghyapātraṃ sadā || tvāṃ devyā sahadehadeva nilaye nāthārcaye sāhibam || 27 ||
mūrkhobhijñatinā katīhabhavanaṃ mittratyarindāsati || kṣmābhṛndokṣati saṃsṛtirnamati vai garbyantako vadyaiti || bhogo yogati kalmaṣaṃ sukṛtati tvatpādukārcotsavā || tvāṃ taṃ staumidayālamītya caraṇaṃ śrīsāhibaṃ śaṅkaram || 30 ||
diṣṭyā triṃśatirhṛdayasya(?) maṇibhiḥ protā maheśātmaka śrīmāheśvara va(?)ryadaiśika pateḥ patstotra ratnāvalī śrīkauleśvara sāhibeti mahita khyātābhidhasyeśi turbhaktyaiṣā viniveditāṅghri kamalesantuṣṭaye jyotiṣā || 31 ||
nāthasyāsya padābjanuṇu bhajanāt prāptaprasādo vibhuḥ || saddharṣācita citsvarūpa sakala jyotiṣprakāśāhvayaḥ ||
śrīdevyai namaḥ
nāgendrāsyartha pālumāpatimukheḥ stutyāṅghra padmopyayaṃ || śarvātmā jayati pradīpita mahāmāheśvaratvāmpadaḥ || 32 ||
śrīśāke śrutināgatarkaśaśi saṃkhyāte'sya viśve śituḥ || pādāmbhoja madhuvrato madhusitāṣṭasyāṃ sa paryotsave || śrīgovinda upāharannavamaṇi śreṇīmimāṃ tvanvahaṃ || yedpyussvagale prathanti(?) sudhiyaste bhogamokṣa śriyam || 33 ||
[iti śrīmahāmāheśvarācāryaśrīmacchrījyotiṣprakāsakaulānandapāda(-) padmānujīviśrīgovindakaulaviracitā śrīgurustutiratnāvalī samāptā cetivam] || saṃvat || 39 || [vaivatidaśasyāṃ citritājñe yaiṣā jñeyavidbhiḥ] ||
śrīdevyai siddhidāyinyai namaḥ ||
śrīgurave śivāyo namaḥ ||
śrīgaṇapataye namaḥ ||
oṃ devadevaṃ mahādevamīśānaṃ śūladhāriṇam | prasannavadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇasyotthāya pārvatī ||
kṛtāñjali puṭā(?)devī vinayā nata mastakā | smita(?) pūrvaṃ vacodīnaṃ jagāda parameśvaram || 2 ||
śrīdevyuvāca |
bhagavanparameśānaśaraṇāgata vatsalā | tvatprasādān mayāsarvaṃ śrutaṃ ḍāmaramuttamam ||
tantrāṇāṃ sāramādyantaṃ yāmalādiṣu vistaram ||
idānīṃ bhagavañśrotumicchāmi tvannivedita navandurgārcanaṃ divyaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitam ||
sarvakāmapradaṃ kāsyaṃ sādhakānāṃ muṇḍavaryam ||
śrībhairavaḥ ||
etad guhyatamaṃ devi na kasya kathitaṃ mayā || pujāṃ samayadīkṣāyāḥ koṭipūjā phalapradāṃ ||
guhyādguhyatamaṃ gopyaṃ kṛtaṃ tadbahukālakam ||
idānīṃ tava vakṣyāhaṃ kathayāmi suvistaram | gopanīyaṃ prayatnena rakṣaṇīyaṃ svaputravat ||
śṛṇuṣvaikenamanasā bhakti pūrveṇa pārvati santi nānāvidhairmantrairā gamoktaissavījakaiḥ || tantrāṇi vividhānyatra sahitāni || maheśvari || 9 ||
te mantrāniṣkalā jātānkalauvīrya vivarjitāḥ strīśuddhirahitāddravyādbhūmyantaśśuddhikāraṇāt || anṛtānmatsarāddabhātpai śunyāddravya lolupāt ||
siddhyanti varārohe sarveniṣphalatāṃgatāḥ || satyāgamānāśāstraṃ tu pratijñā siddhameva ca ||
anādareṇa tadduṣṭaṃ gurubhaktiṃ vinā tathā tanmadhye sārabhūtaṃ tu pratyakṣa phaladāyakam || rudrayāmalatantraṃ ca catuṣṣaṣṭyātmakaṃ parama || nānāvidhaiḥ śubhairmantrairyuktaṃ samaya pūjanaiḥ ||
vinā samayadīkṣādyairmantrardīkṣāpi niṣphalā || samayo hi śive brahmā samayo viṣṇureva hi samayaśśiva evasyātsamayo mṛtyureva ca || 15 ||
siddhyanti sadā devi vaṃ rārohe nityapūjājapādayaḥ || yajñā hemādayo devi vinā samaya pūja vā kālesaṃ pūja
